boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten distinct Moon Campus places with documented student-facing uses, from a multipurpose gathering room to recreation, study, support, and campus-life spaces.

cards.title: Olsen Family Basement
cards.subtitle: Nicholson Center • student gathering space
cards.notes: Bring a group for the pool and ping-pong tables, TVs, and stage; the space also includes commuter amenities and a conference room.
cards.short_summary: A documented multipurpose room for hanging out, games, and small-group time.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU describes the Olsen Family Basement in Nicholson Center as a central student gathering place with furniture, TVs, pool and ping-pong tables, a stage, commuter amenities, and a conference room.
cards.source_title: Robert Morris University Announces New Named Spaces on Campus
cards.access_notes: Located inside Nicholson Center; check building access and event use before visiting.

cards.title: Gazebo
cards.subtitle: 316 Massey Way • Moon Campus
cards.notes: Use this named outdoor gathering spot for a meet-up or a quiet pause between classes; keep plans flexible around weather and scheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: A small, named student gathering space on Massey Way.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists the Gazebo at 316 Massey Way on Moon Campus with the primary use “Student Gathering Space.”
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space on Moon Campus; weather and campus programming may affect use.

cards.title: Jefferson Center
cards.subtitle: 346 Massey Way • services, fitness, and computers
cards.notes: Head here when you need the documented fitness center, Veterans Lounge, Student Health Services, or the 24/7 computer lab in one building.
cards.short_summary: One campus building that combines practical student services with fitness and computing.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Jefferson Center’s primary uses as Student Health Services, Fitness Center, Vets Lounge, Phonathon, and a 24/7 Computer Lab.
cards.access_notes: Services and building access can have separate eligibility and operating requirements.

cards.title: RMU Nature Trail
cards.subtitle: Behind Jefferson Center and Colonial Village
cards.notes: Take the documented mile-long loop for a daytime walk; it begins behind Jefferson Center and returns behind Colonial Village.
cards.short_summary: A named one-mile campus loop for a low-key outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that its mile-long Nature Trail starts behind Jefferson Center and loops back around behind Colonial Village.
cards.access_notes: Use appropriate daylight and weather judgment; trail conditions are not stated on the source.

cards.title: Student Recreation and Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: North Athletic Complex • recreation programming
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule, complete any required waiver, and choose from the documented indoor club, intramural, group-exercise, and wellness activity options.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation hub for organized sports, fitness, and wellness programming.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says its Student Recreation and Fitness Center houses indoor club sports, intramural sports, group exercise, and physical wellness programming.
cards.access_notes: Membership, waiver, and facility rules apply; check the current recreation page before arrival.

cards.title: Gus Krop Gym
cards.subtitle: John Jay Center • indoor intramurals
cards.notes: Look for intramural or club-sport activity in this gym; it can be arranged as a main basketball or volleyball court or smaller basketball courts.
cards.short_summary: A current-student gym for indoor intramurals and club-sport practices.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that Gus Krop Gym in John Jay Center houses indoor intramural activities and is used by club sports teams for weekly practices.
cards.access_notes: RMU says the gym is only for current RMU students; follow posted scheduling and facility rules.

cards.title: Patrick Henry Center
cards.subtitle: 310 Massey Way • library and academic support
cards.notes: Use the library facilities when you need a study-oriented stop, then pair it with a Career Center or Honors Lounge appointment if relevant.
cards.short_summary: A campus academic building that combines library resources with student-success offices.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Patrick Henry Center’s primary uses as Library, Career Center, Honors Lounge, and Academic Affairs.
cards.access_notes: Library and office access may vary by service and academic calendar.

cards.title: Massey Hall
cards.subtitle: 372 Massey Way • performing arts and theatre
cards.notes: Watch for performances or program activity connected to this performing-arts and theatre building; confirm event details before making a special trip.
cards.short_summary: A named campus destination associated with performing arts and theatre.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Massey Hall’s primary uses as Performing Arts, Theatre, and School of Business faculty offices.
cards.access_notes: Performance and event access depend on the particular program or reservation.

cards.title: Melvin D. Teetz House
cards.subtitle: 359 Massey Way • Center for Global Engagement
cards.notes: Make this your starting point for questions about global-engagement opportunities, and contact the center before visiting for program-specific guidance.
cards.short_summary: The named home of RMU’s Center for Global Engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Melvin D. Teetz House at 359 Massey Way on Moon Campus with the primary use “Center for Global Engagement.”
cards.access_notes: Office services and availability may be appointment- or calendar-dependent.

cards.title: Rogal Family Chapel
cards.subtitle: 419 Pennsylvania Avenue • Campus Ministry
cards.notes: Check Campus Ministry programming if you want to visit this dedicated chapel space, and observe any service or reservation guidance when you arrive.
cards.short_summary: A named campus chapel associated with Campus Ministry.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Rogal Family Chapel at 419 Pennsylvania Avenue on Moon Campus with the primary use “Campus Ministry.”
cards.access_notes: Access and worship-program details may vary; consult Campus Ministry before visiting.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten officially listed, no-fee Moon Township activities near Robert Morris University.

cards.entity_name: Friday Fly By Concert in the Park
cards.title: Hear Nathan King at Moon Park
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Meet friends at the amphitheater for the township’s listed Friday Fly By concert. Food vendors are optional, so skip them to keep the hang free.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor concert with optional vendors nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists the August 7 Friday Fly By Concert in the Park with Nathan King at Moon Park Amphitheater and a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the event FREE; food and beverage vendors are on-site but optional.

cards.entity_name: Movies in the Moonlight: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial
cards.title: Catch E.T. after dusk
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or chair and settle in after dusk for the township’s outdoor screening. Pack your own snacks if you want to spend nothing.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee outdoor movie night at the amphitheater.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists Movies in the Moonlight: E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial at Moon Park Amphitheater on August 21 with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the screening FREE; scheduled for dusk, approximately 8:30 p.m.

cards.title: Watch the Animal Show
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Join the early-evening Animal Show at the amphitheater with classmates, younger siblings, or visiting family—no ticket purchase is listed.
cards.short_summary: A free, family-friendly amphitheater program.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists its Children's Amphitheater Event, an Animal Show at Moon Park Amphitheater, with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the event FREE and gives a 6 p.m. start.

cards.entity_name: Robin Hill Lunchtime Concert: Kevin Solecki
cards.title: Take a lunch-break concert walk
cards.subtitle: Robin Hill Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Head to Robin Hill Park for Kevin Solecki’s lunchtime accordion set. Bring lunch from home or simply listen and walk the grounds.
cards.short_summary: A free midday concert in Robin Hill Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists a Robin Hill Lunchtime Concert by Kevin Solecki at Robin Hill Park on August 19 with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the concert FREE; listed time is noon to 1 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Children's Amphitheater Event: Eyes on the Sky
cards.title: Learn storm-spotting outdoors
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Meet up for Eyes on the Sky: Become a Storm Spotter, then make an evening stroll through Moon Park part of the outing.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor educational program at Moon Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists Eyes on the Sky: Become a Storm Spotter as a Children's Amphitheater Event at Moon Park with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the event FREE and gives a 6 p.m. start.

cards.entity_name: Robin Hill Lunchtime Concert: Doo Wop Drs
cards.title: Listen to the Doo Wop Drs
cards.subtitle: Robin Hill Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Plan a midday break at Robin Hill Park for the Doo Wop Drs concert. The listing identifies it as free, with no purchase required.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee lunchtime concert in a named township park.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists a Robin Hill Lunchtime Concert by the Doo Wop Drs at Robin Hill Park on September 16 with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the concert FREE; listed time is noon to 1 p.m.

cards.title: See Casper under the sky
cards.subtitle: Moon Park Amphitheater • Moon Township
cards.notes: Make a low-key fall plan around the listed outdoor Casper screening. Bring a seat and snacks from home to preserve the zero-dollar plan.
cards.short_summary: A free fall movie screening at the Moon Park Amphitheater.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists Movies in the Moonlight: Casper at Moon Park Amphitheater on October 2 with a FREE fee.
cards.access_notes: Township listing marks the screening FREE; scheduled for dusk, approximately 7:30 p.m.

cards.title: Get close to working vehicles
cards.subtitle: Moon Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Walk through the vehicle displays, talk with their operators, and take photos at this township event. Food trucks are present but not required.
cards.short_summary: A free all-ages vehicle-display event.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township’s Touch A Truck listing says attendance is free and invites visitors to see vehicles and talk with the people who use them.
cards.access_notes: Official listing says “Free to attend”; it notes food trucks on site, which are optional.

cards.title: Join Moon Township Earth Day
cards.subtitle: Robin Hill Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Use the afternoon to browse the listed vendors and activities at Robin Hill Park. The township identifies the event itself as free.
cards.short_summary: A free township environmental event with vendors and activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township lists its Earth Day event at Robin Hill Park with a Free cost and says it includes vendors and activities.
cards.access_notes: Official calendar lists the cost as Free; individual vendor offerings are not represented as free.

cards.title: Drive through Moon’s holiday lights
cards.subtitle: Moon Park • Moon Township
cards.notes: Coordinate a carpool for the township’s nighttime lights route through Moon Park. Viewing is listed as free; bring only what you need.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal drive-through light display.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Township describes the Moon Holiday Lights Drive-Thru at Moon Park as FREE and lists nightly hours from 5 to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Moon Township Moon Holiday Lights Drive-Thru
cards.access_notes: Official calendar lists the fee as Free and identifies the program as a drive-through; verify the current season’s dates before going.

warnings: Several official township listings are date-specific 2026 events; confirm dates before making plans. Optional food vendors are not included in the free-cost claim.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented RMU study environments, from library work areas to residence-hall lounges with study tables.

cards.title: Elaine Boyd Library
cards.subtitle: Patrick Henry Center, Moon Campus
cards.notes: Start here when you need a choice of quiet and group settings; bring your laptop and use the library’s wireless network.
cards.short_summary: RMU’s main library combines quiet and collaborative study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU identifies its library in Patrick Henry as including quiet and group spaces, some with computers and whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Residence Hall Amenities | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Patrick Henry Center on campus; confirm current building access and library hours before arrival.

cards.title: Library 24-7 Zone
cards.subtitle: Elaine Boyd Library, Patrick Henry Center
cards.notes: Use this computer-equipped library zone for a late independent work session; check campus status before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A library zone with Windows computers and availability outside standard library hours.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says the Library’s 24-7 Zone has Windows computers and that 24-7 quiet study space is available whenever campus is not closed.
cards.access_notes: RMU states 24-7 quiet study is available anytime campus is not closed; standard library service hours vary.

cards.title: Library Research Room
cards.subtitle: Elaine Boyd Library, Patrick Henry Center
cards.notes: Choose the Research Room when you need library PCs for a focused task; save work to your account or a flash drive.
cards.short_summary: A named library room with small tables and PCs for research work.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s library services page says two small tables with PCs are located within the Library’s Research Room.
cards.access_notes: Inside the library; access is subject to current library and campus building hours.

cards.title: Elaine Boyd Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Elaine Boyd Library, Patrick Henry Center
cards.notes: Ask at the library help desk about a study-room key, then plan your session around the documented three-hour loan period.
cards.short_summary: Library study rooms with keys loaned for three hours.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Study Room Keys with a three-hour borrowing period for students.
cards.source_title: Library General Resources | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Study-room keys are borrowed through the library; RMU lists a three-hour loan period.

cards.title: Elaine Boyd Library Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Elaine Boyd Library, Patrick Henry Center
cards.notes: Set up at a table with an outlet when your laptop needs a long charge; library wireless supports personal devices.
cards.short_summary: Outlet-equipped tables designed for laptop-based study.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU reports that the library has many study tables equipped with outlets for recharging laptops.
cards.access_notes: Inside the library; verify current library hours and access before planning a session.

cards.title: Jefferson Center 24/7 Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Center, 346 Massey Way
cards.notes: Use this named computer lab when you need a campus workstation; bring your RMU credentials and confirm current building access.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 computer lab in RMU’s Jefferson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists the Jefferson Center’s primary uses as including a 24/7 Computer Lab.
cards.access_notes: RMU lists the lab as 24/7; building-entry requirements and any temporary restrictions should be confirmed locally.

cards.entity_name: Center for Veterans and Military Families
cards.title: Center for Veterans and Military Families
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Jefferson Center
cards.notes: Military-affiliated students can use the center’s quiet study area or computer lab; contact CVMF first to confirm eligibility.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated support center with quiet study space and a computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU describes its Center for Veterans and Military Families as having a computer lab, quiet study area, lounge space, and conference room.
cards.source_title: RMU Center for Veterans and Military Families | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: The center serves military-connected students and families; contact CVMF for eligibility and current access details.

cards.title: Hamilton Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Hall, Moon Campus
cards.notes: Hamilton residents can use its lounge’s study tables for a close-to-home work block; respect resident-only access and shared use.
cards.short_summary: A renovated residence-hall lounge with study tables and a community kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says residence lounges have study tables and identifies Hamilton Hall’s lounge as equipped with a modern community kitchen.
cards.source_title: Residence Hall Amenities | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: A residence-hall lounge; access is for the residential community and subject to Residence Life policies.

cards.title: Marshall Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Marshall Hall, Moon Campus
cards.notes: Marshall residents can settle into the lounge’s study tables between classes; leave the space ready for the next community use.
cards.short_summary: A renovated Marshall Hall lounge with study tables and a community kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says residence lounges have study tables and identifies Marshall Hall’s lounge as equipped with a modern community kitchen.
cards.source_title: Residence Hall Amenities | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: A residence-hall lounge; access is for the residential community and subject to Residence Life policies.

cards.title: Yorktown Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Yorktown Hall, 8256 University Boulevard
cards.notes: Yorktown residents can use lounge study tables for a nearby session; account for the hall’s off-campus location when planning travel.
cards.short_summary: A Yorktown residence lounge with study tables and a community kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says residence lounges have study tables and identifies Yorktown Hall’s lounge as equipped with a modern community kitchen.
cards.source_title: Residence Hall Amenities | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Yorktown is a residence-hall space about a mile up University Boulevard from campus; resident access applies.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along the University Boulevard corridor beside Robert Morris University, each with a direct source for its practical reason to stop.

cards.title: Yorktown Hall for conference-center events
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, about one mile from RMU
cards.notes: Check the event schedule or contact Conference Services before heading over; Yorktown is off campus, across from Moon Area High School.
cards.short_summary: RMU’s off-campus conference center is a distinct University Boulevard stop.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU identifies Yorktown Hall at 8256 University Blvd. as its Conference Center and says it hosts events with multiple rooms and external guests.
cards.access_notes: Event spaces are reserved through RMU Conference and Facilities Services.

cards.title: Yorktown Café for an RMU dining stop
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, inside Yorktown Hall
cards.notes: Use the café’s listed breakfast, lunch, dinner, or milkshake offerings as the reason to visit; confirm current service details with RMU.
cards.short_summary: A named café located at RMU’s Yorktown Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that Yorktown Café is at the bottom of Yorktown Hall and offers breakfast, lunch, dinner, milkshakes, and homemade ice cream.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Yorktown Hall; availability may depend on café operations and building access.

cards.title: Moon Area High School for the calendar
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, across from Yorktown Hall
cards.notes: Look at the public school calendar before planning around this landmark, and respect school access rules while visiting the corridor.
cards.short_summary: A named public-school destination on University Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Moon Area High School’s official contact page lists its address as 8353 University Boulevard in Moon Township.
cards.access_notes: This is an operating school; public access is governed by district policies and scheduled events.

cards.entity_name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Pittsburgh Airport
cards.title: DoubleTree for its indoor pool and fitness center
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, 8402 University Blvd.
cards.notes: For a planned stay or event, use the hotel’s official page to confirm amenities and booking terms before making arrangements.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard hotel with documented recreation and meeting amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Hilton lists the DoubleTree at 8402 University Blvd. and identifies an indoor pool, fitness center, restaurant, and meeting rooms.
cards.source_title: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Pittsburgh Airport
cards.access_notes: Hotel amenities and event spaces are intended for guests or booked functions; check availability directly.

cards.title: Eggs N'at for a breakfast-and-lunch address
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, 8556 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Plan this as a daytime food stop and verify service before leaving; the chamber listing identifies the restaurant and its University Boulevard address.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant on the corridor with a directly documented address.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pittsburgh Airport Area Chamber of Commerce lists Eggs N'at, LLC as a restaurant at 8556 University Boulevard, Moon Township.
cards.source_title: Eggs N'at, LLC | Pittsburgh Airport Area Chamber of Commerce
cards.access_notes: Restaurant access and service are subject to current operating hours.

cards.title: Primanti Bros. for a documented restaurant stop
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, 8651 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Use the official location page for directions and current hours before visiting; this is the chain’s named Moon Township location.
cards.short_summary: A directly listed Primanti Bros. location on University Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Primanti Bros.’ official locator lists its Moon location at 8651 University Boulevard, Moon Township.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current hours and ordering options on the official location page.

cards.title: Walgreens for a pharmacy stop
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, 6906 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Use this named pharmacy location for planned essentials, and check the official store tools or call ahead for any item-specific availability.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard pharmacy location documented by Walgreens.
cards.evidence_claim: Walgreens’ official employment site lists a store at 6906 University Blvd., Moon Township, PA 15108.
cards.access_notes: Retail access and pharmacy services depend on current store operations.

cards.title: RMU’s main campus for the mapped campus grounds
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, 6001 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Start with RMU’s official map and directions page to orient yourself to campus buildings, parking guidance, and the University Boulevard approach.
cards.short_summary: The campus anchor for this University Boulevard route.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s official map and directions page gives the main-campus address as 6001 University Blvd., Moon Township.
cards.source_title: University Map and Directions | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Follow RMU visitor parking guidance and campus access procedures.

cards.title: Eat'n Park for its meeting-room option
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, 9516 University Blvd.
cards.notes: If gathering with a small group, review the official location page first; it lists a meeting room alongside dining and pickup services.
cards.short_summary: A University Boulevard restaurant with a documented meeting-room service.
cards.evidence_claim: Eat'n Park’s official Moon Township page lists 9516 University Blvd. and identifies dining, pickup, delivery, bakery, and meeting-room services.
cards.access_notes: The page says meeting-room use has a food-purchase minimum; confirm all current terms directly.

cards.title: University Boulevard Park and Ride for G3 access
cards.subtitle: University Boulevard corridor, 9000 University Blvd.
cards.notes: Use this as a weekday commuter stop for the G3 Moon Flyer; follow PRT rules because the lot is not for overnight or recreational parking.
cards.short_summary: A named transit destination on the corridor with G3 Moon Flyer service.
cards.evidence_claim: Pittsburgh Regional Transit lists the University Boulevard Park and Ride at 9000 University Blvd., with 600 spaces, no parking fee, and G3 Moon Flyer service.
cards.source_title: University Boulevard Park and Ride Information | Pittsburgh Regional Transit
cards.access_notes: Parking is available weekdays only and is for commuter parking; PRT states it is not for overnight, long-term, commercial, residential, or recreational use.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Robert Morris University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for learning the Moon Township campus, meeting people, and choosing a recurring way to participate.

cards.title: Start with New Student Orientation
cards.subtitle: Arrival and campus-introduction stop
cards.notes: Use the orientation schedule to locate key offices, ask practical questions, and introduce yourself to students in your group before making separate plans.
cards.short_summary: Begin with the university’s structured welcome program and campus orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU describes New Student Orientation as a time for new Colonials to get acquainted with campus and meet students from around the world.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Follow the current orientation schedule and any attendee instructions from RMU.

cards.title: Share a Table at PNC Food Court
cards.subtitle: Campus dining stop
cards.notes: Meet your orientation group for a meal, then use the posted dining information to compare stations and plan another convenient campus meal together.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining location with rotating menus and several food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists the PNC Food Court as a dining location with daily-changing featured items, including salad, soup, deli, pizza, pasta, and rotating culinary concepts.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and payment depend on the current RMU dining plan or other accepted payment.

cards.title: Find One Way to Get Involved
cards.subtitle: Student Life activity-planning stop
cards.notes: Browse current opportunities through the Student Experience Office, then choose one club, performance, volunteer activity, or new-group idea to explore this semester.
cards.short_summary: A starting point for RMU student clubs, organizations, and social or educational programming.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says its Student Experience Office provides educational and social programs and connects students with more than 120 clubs and organizations.
cards.source_title: Student Experience Office | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Check RMU Revolution and the office’s current event listings for participation details.

cards.title: Take a Rec Center Lap
cards.subtitle: Campus Recreation stop
cards.notes: Complete any required waiver, bring your RMU ID, and try a workout, group-fitness option, or casual recreation session that fits your comfort level.
cards.short_summary: RMU’s recreation hub for fitness, club sports, intramurals, and wellness programming.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that the Student Recreation and Fitness Center houses indoor club sports, intramurals, group exercise, and wellness programming.
cards.access_notes: RMU lists academic-year hours as Monday–Thursday 6 a.m.–midnight, Friday 6 a.m.–10 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m.–8 p.m., and Sunday 8 a.m.–midnight; verify changes before going.

cards.title: Walk the RMU Nature Trail
cards.subtitle: Outdoor reset near Jefferson Center and Colonial Village
cards.notes: Take the marked mile-long loop with a friend in daylight, keeping the walk conversational and using it to notice landmarks between Jefferson Center and Colonial Village.
cards.short_summary: A documented one-mile campus trail for a short outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU describes a mile-long nature trail beginning behind the Jefferson Center and looping back behind Colonial Village.
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and normal trail-safety practices; conditions and access can change with weather.

cards.title: Check the Colonial Theatre Calendar
cards.subtitle: Arts and performance stop
cards.notes: See whether a production, audition, or related student activity is scheduled, then invite someone from your hall to attend or learn how to participate.
cards.short_summary: An RMU student-life destination associated with campus theatre programming.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s Student Life page includes Colonial Theatre among its student-life resources, and the Student Experience Office invites students to audition for theatre productions.
cards.access_notes: Performance dates, tickets, and audition requirements vary; consult the current RMU listing.

cards.title: Set Up a Library Basecamp
cards.subtitle: Study and campus-resource stop
cards.notes: Locate the library early, check its service desk and study options, and save its contact details so you have a dependable place for your first assignments.
cards.short_summary: RMU’s named campus library and a practical academic anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s current student organization guidelines list Elaine Boyd Library in the campus department directory.
cards.source_title: Student Organization Guidelines 2025–2026 | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Verify current building access and library hours directly with the library before visiting.

cards.title: Pause at Rogal Family Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry and reflection stop
cards.notes: Visit respectfully during open access, then review Campus Ministry’s student-group information if you want a faith-based, service, or social connection.
cards.short_summary: A named campus chapel connected to RMU Campus Ministry student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s Campus Ministry page identifies the Ann & Alvin Rogal Family Chapel and says its student groups offer faith-based activities, service projects, and social events.
cards.source_title: Student Groups & Upcoming Events | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Programs are optional and vary by group; contact Campus Ministry for current meeting details.

cards.title: Ask About Intramural Sign-Ups
cards.subtitle: John Jay Center recreation stop
cards.notes: If a casual league sounds appealing, ask about current registration and join solo or with new classmates; staff can help place participants on incomplete teams.
cards.short_summary: A John Jay Center gym used for indoor intramural activities and club-sport practices.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU states that Gus Krop Gym, inside the John Jay Center, hosts indoor intramural activities and weekly RMU club-sport practices.
cards.access_notes: RMU says the gym is for current students and asks users to bring their RMU ID; confirm schedules before arrival.

cards.title: End with a Campus Game or Event
cards.subtitle: North Athletic Complex event stop
cards.notes: Check the official schedule for a basketball, volleyball, or other listed event, then make a plan with new friends and follow venue entry guidance.
cards.short_summary: A major RMU event venue and home court for basketball and volleyball.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU identifies the UPMC Events Center as part of the North Athletic Complex and the home of its men’s and women’s basketball and volleyball teams.
cards.access_notes: Event availability, admission, and venue policies vary; use the official RMU schedule before attending.
